newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower in all months.

text.p: All months of Tokyo corn futures closed sharply lower on Tuesday, as individual investors were discouraged by a weaker Chicago market overnight, traders said.

Prices were 70 to 550 yen lower, with the benchmark November 1997 contract down 70 yen at 13,800 yen per tonne. The limitless spot January 1997 contract was down 550 yen at 14,960. Daily volume was 65,316 lots.
Active fresh selling hit the market from the opening, traders said. "Technical selling from some powerful investors accelerated price falls by the afternoon session," a brokerage house trader said.
The spot December contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.66 per bushel at 0905 GMT, against $2.66-1/2 at Monday's close.
The spot January contract of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $7.03 at 0905 GMT, unchanged from Monday's close.
